title: Contact Form 7 Setup
description: Configure Contact Form 7 forms with reliable delivery, spam protection, and GDPR-friendly notices.

steps.title: Create & Label Forms
steps.instructions: Build forms for contact, quote, and support use cases. Use clear field labels, required markers, and accessible error messages.

steps.title: Configure Mail & Mail (2)
steps.instructions: Set recipient, subject, and body tokens. Enable autoresponder Mail (2) only when the client wants confirmation emails.

steps.title: Verify Email Delivery
steps.instructions: Route mail through SMTP or transactional provider if host mail is unreliable. Send test submissions from staging and production.

steps.title: Add Spam Protection
steps.instructions: Enable reCAPTCHA v3, Turnstile, or Akismet integration. Confirm spam submissions are blocked without blocking real users.

steps.title: Enable Message Storage (Optional)
steps.instructions: Install Flamingo or equivalent if the client needs an inbox of submissions. Restrict access to trusted admin roles.

steps.title: Add Privacy & Consent Copy
steps.instructions: Link to privacy policy near forms. Add consent checkbox if marketing follow-up or CRM sync is enabled.

steps.title: Embed Forms & Test UX
steps.instructions: Place shortcodes or blocks on contact pages. Test validation, mobile layout, and success messages after submit.
